description: Rules the specification itself declares non-testable. Every entry must name a FeatureId whose `Conformance` cell is NOT_COVERED, explain why no executable case can exist, cite the normative text, and state the condition under which the exemption must be re-examined. `python tools/features_coverage.py --strict` fails if an entry is malformed, unknown, stale or hides an uncited rule.

exemptions.reason: La ligne declare elle-meme « pass : aucun (oracle absent) » et sa colonne Conformance vaut NOT_COVERED. La machine abstraite du noyau pur n'a aucune forme executable : MACH-1.4 fixe son etat a NOT_IMPLEMENTED et interdit de citer un resultat machine comme preuve. Inventer un cas reviendrait a inventer un oracle, ce qui est precisement le faux PASS que T2 doit interdire.
exemptions.review_condition: Revoquer cette exemption des qu'une machine abstraite executable existe (MACH-1.4 quitte NOT_IMPLEMENTED) ou si la ligne F-META-006 obtient une forme executable ; la couverture stricte doit alors repasser a 188/188 sans exemption. Reexamen obligatoire au plus tard le 2027-02-12 (90 jours apres l'approbation humaine du 2026-11-12).
exemptions.approved_by: Rwanbt (responsable du projet) — approbation explicite en session le 2026-11-12, reponse « 1 - ok » a la demande d'approbation de l'exemption F-META-006.

line_coverage_exemptions.owner_decision: S5, APPROUVÉ par le responsable, 2026-11-14 : « Objectif de couverture : 100 % lignes et régions du CODE PRODUIT, hors modules #[cfg(test)] et hors chemins inatteignables documentés un par un. » Ce bloc est la liste « un par un ».
line_coverage_exemptions.policy: Une entrée n'est admise que si AUCUNE entrée de programme acceptée n'emprunte la ligne, et chaque entrée porte la preuve (test qui exécute le refus, mesure, ou argument statique sur le parseur/checker). Une entrée n'est PAS une auto-approbation : elle reste `PENDING_HUMAN_APPROVAL`, n'est jamais défalquée du chiffre brut, et le chiffre « objectif S5 » est publié séparément. Une entrée sans preuve est interdite ; une ligne inatteignable non listée reste une dette de couverture comptée. Ce fichier ne modifie aucun seuil (`tools/coverage_thresholds.json`).
line_coverage_exemptions.measured_on: 2026-11-14 (vague 3, agent F), branche goal/wave-3 + branche wave3/f-coverage-mutation

entries.summary: `builtin_const` arms for `math::PI`/`E`/`TAU` and the primitive `MIN`/`MAX`/`EPSILON` parsing.
entries.why_unreachable: The resolver produces exactly one builtin constant, `Resolution::BuiltinConst("Option::None")` (resolve.rs `"None" => ...`); `math::PI` and the primitive associated constants are not resolved at all, so those arms cannot be selected. The reachable `Option::None` arm is covered.
entries.proof: Measured: `let pi = math::PI;` → `E-RES-UNKNOWN: unknown name `PI``. Code: crates/ravum-lang-sema/src/resolve.rs maps only `None` to `ValuePath::BuiltinConst`.
entries.review_condition: L'exposition d'une constante builtin autre que `Option::None` (par exemple `math::PI`).

entries.why_unreachable: RFC-OWN-FACTS-1 step B is a debug-only audit guard: the branch is compiled out in release builds and is never executed in a debug build. Coverage is measured on a debug build (`cargo llvm-cov` without `--release`), so the line cannot be covered by any test in the measured profile.
entries.proof: The guard is `if !cfg!(debug_assertions) { return Ok(()); }`; the instrumented profile is the default debug profile. The *other* direction (a disagreement between `OwnFacts` and the emitter) is covered by the crate's own unit test.
entries.review_condition: Une mesure de couverture en profil release, ou la suppression de la garde de debug.

entries.summary: `PathRoot::Plain` arms comparing the first segment to `crate`/`self`/`super`, the `levels` loops for `super::super`, and the `Self` prefix test.
entries.why_unreachable: `parser::parse_path` consumes `crate`/`self`/`super` as a `PathRoot` before segmentation, and `Self` is the keyword `Kw::SelfType` (it can never be an `Ident` segment). A plain path therefore never starts with those words, and `super::super` is itself a parse error.
entries.proof: Measured: `use crate::…` / `use self::…` parse into `PathRoot::Crate`/`SelfMod` (no `E-PARSE-EXPECTED`); `use super::super::Something;` is refused with `E-PARSE-EXPECTED: expected path segment, found keyword `super``. Same argument as MUTATION-EQUIVALENCE.md §9.2 (E2), re-measured here.
entries.review_condition: Un parseur qui accepterait `crate`/`self`/`super`/`Self` comme segments ordinaires, ou `super::super::…` comme chemin.

entries.summary: Ownership bookkeeping for a destructuring `let` pattern (`let (a, b) = …`).
entries.why_unreachable: Core 1.0 `let` binds exactly one identifier: a destructuring pattern reaches the checker and is refused fail-closed (`E-PARSE-EXPECTED`, « `let` binds exactly one identifier in Core 1.0 ») before ownership analysis runs.
entries.proof: Measured: `let (text, number): (&str, i32) = ("abc", 1);` → `E-PARSE-EXPECTED` with that message; no `CheckedProgram` is produced.
entries.review_condition: L'acceptation d'un motif de `let` autre qu'une liaison simple.

entries.summary: AST fallback of `own::check_fn` when `Facts::fn_sigs` has no signature for the function.
entries.why_unreachable: `own` runs inside `check`, after `resolve`/`typeck` filled `fn_sigs` for every function of the program, and a `CheckedProgram` is only produced when no diagnostic error was reported (fail-closed). A function without a signature therefore cannot be reached by ownership analysis.
entries.proof: Static invariant: `check_entry_with_timings` returns `checked: None` as soon as a phase reported an error; `resolve::World::build_module` records a `Sym::Fn` (hence a `FnSig`) for every `ItemKind::Fn`.
entries.review_condition: Un appel direct d'`own` sur un programme partiellement vérifié, ou une signature manquante possible après `typeck`.

entries.summary: `fmt::Error` and parse-recovery edges of `builtins.rs` (display of effect names, malformed type text). METRIC: regions — the file is at 100 % lines; the lines below are the region-entry lines of the error edges (75-76, 948, 977-985).
entries.why_unreachable: The `?` edges of the `Display` impls cannot fail for the same reason as E-LINE-DISPLAY-FMT-ERROR; the recovery edges of `type_from_str` are reached only by malformed spec text that the checked-in specification does not contain (and the strict parser refuses it rather than recovering).
entries.proof: Line coverage of `builtins.rs` is 100 %: only the error regions of the `?` operators remain at zero (COVERAGE-100-OBJECTIVE.md §2).
entries.review_condition: Un formateur faillible, ou une entrée de spécification malformée ajoutée au dépôt.

entries.summary: `package.<key> must be a string` and `dependency path must be a string` branches of `parse_manifest`.
entries.why_unreachable: The manifest TOML reader only produces `TomlValue::Str` and `TomlValue::Table`; a bare integer/bool is refused earlier with `E-MOD-MANIFEST: unsupported TOML value`, and an inline-table entry must be a quoted string. `parse_manifest` therefore never sees a non-string scalar.
entries.proof: Measured: `name = 5` → `E-MOD-MANIFEST: unsupported TOML value `5``; `dep = { path = 5 }` → `E-MOD-MANIFEST: inline table entry `path = 5` must be `key = "value"``.
entries.review_condition: Un lecteur TOML qui produirait d'autres types de valeurs (entiers, booléens, tableaux).

entries.summary: `unreachable!()` / `unreachable!("checked above")` arms after an exhaustive `match` on the same key.
entries.why_unreachable: Both arms are guarded by an immediately preceding `match` on the same value (`key` is one of `name`/`version`/`edition`; a path component was already classified as `Normal`/`CurDir`/`ParentDir`). Reaching them would require the two matches to disagree, which no input can cause.
entries.proof: Static proof: the arm bodies are `unreachable!()` / `unreachable!("checked above")` directly under the exhaustive match that establishes the invariant.
entries.review_condition: Toute modification des deux `match` qui romprait l'invariant « checked above ».
